confidence_notes: Food anchors rest on Essaouira-specific aggregator estimates (a cheap meal of about $4-5) and are the most reliable. Beer and coffee lean on other Moroccan towns and Marrakech hotel menus, so they are less certain. Beer is a bottled domestic beer proxy for draft. Cocktail and wine are set relative to beer (about 2.3 and 1.6 times the beer anchor) because direct local evidence was weak. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. The FX value is the most recent RBA figure I could verify (2026-03-20), not the 2026-11-19 value, so it should be refreshed before conversion.
comparable_city_reasoning: Essaouira-specific meal estimates from aggregator guides, adjusted down for a smaller, quieter coastal town compared with Marrakech. Coffee and beer were checked against other Moroccan towns (Ouarzazate, Ifrane) and Marrakech hotel menus. Cocktail and wine follow the beer ratio. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate with no accommodation search.
